base_url.correction: Local resource root: https://<bridge-ip>/clip/v2/resource; remote resource root: https://api.meethue.com/route/clip/v2/resource

auth_type.correction: Local access uses an application key in the hue-application-key header; remote access uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer authorization plus hue-application-key, not X-Api-Key.

free_tier_limits.correction: No official 1,000-requests/day free-tier limit was found; the published remote API quota is 50,000 calls per day.

rate_limits.correction: Remote API: 50,000 calls/day. Local guidance: roughly 10 commands/second for lights and 1 command/second for groups.

notes: Hue remains active, with official API updates published in 2026. The example combines an invalid cloud path and header with a v1-style response. Pricing and CORS could not be established officially. The duplicated weather use cases are unrelated to Hue, and the sources list is largely duplicated.
